regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Palisades is forecast for about 20", 16" of it Thursday. Kirkwood and Sugar Bowl follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Palisades Thursday. The NWS is calling for more at Palisades: 18 to 33 inches Thursday through Sunday night. Winter Storm Warning at Palisades from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbasin is forecast for about 16", 11" of it Friday. Powder Mountain and Snowbird follow. The NWS is calling for more at Powder Mountain: 14 to 28 inches Thursday through Monday. Winter Weather Advisory at Snowbasin from Thursday to Saturday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 15", 14" of it Thursday. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Thursday. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 21 to 33 inches Thursday through Sunday night. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 10", 6" of it Friday. Jackson Hole and Sun Valley follow. The NWS is calling for more at Grand Targhee: 11 to 29 inches Thursday through Monday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 10". Crested Butte and Aspen Highlands follow. The NWS is calling for more at Crested Butte: 2 to 10 inches Thursday night through Monday night.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 7", 4" of it Monday. Taos follows.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
